Maya Chen: Hey team — quick heads up. Enterprise trial with Acme Logistics is trending down (usage flat after week 1). Renewal call next Tue. Thinking we should offer a 'soft-landing' downgrade pathway so they don't churn — temporary lower tier + 30 days of targeted enablement + usage credits to prove value. Thoughts?

Liam O'Neill: :wave: Agree on soft-landing. Keeps them in product, cheaper than churn. Recommend we define a clear 30-day success window and an activation checklist.

Raghu Patel: +1. We should spell out 3 success metrics (e.g., daily active users, fwded requests, model utilization) and commit to a 1:1 onboarding for those topics. If they reach metric thresholds we auto-escalate rollback to original tier.

Samira Gomez: Also capture qualitative feedback — two quick questions after the enablement session: (1) biggest blocker, (2) most valuable outcome. Use that to inform our feature/enablement notes.

onboarding-bot: Task created: CS-3928 — schedule Acme enablement session. Assignee: Maya Chen. Link: https://redwood/tasks/CS-3928

Maya Chen: Cool. Drafting the outreach email now — dropping below so we can iterate.

Maya Chen: ```
Subject: Quick enablement + flexible plan to keep Acme productive

Hi [Name],

We noticed your team’s usage leveled off after week 1 — we’d love to make sure you get back to value quickly. We can do a short, hands-on enablement session focused on your top use cases and offer a temporary "soft-landing" plan: reduced monthly spend for 30 days + one month of usage credits while you run the enablement playbook.

If that sounds helpful I can schedule a 45-minute session this week. We’ll also follow up with two quick feedback questions so we can act on blockers immediately.

Best,
Maya (CSM)
```

Liam O'Neill: Email looks good. Recommend adding an explicit renewal checkpoint date and a clear next step CTA: "Pick a time here: <cal.link>"

Samira Gomez: Also add a line: "If you'd prefer a cost-based alternative, we can temporarily move you to our Grace Tier with reduced features and retention, then migrate you back once you hit the success metrics." Keep the migration assistance promise.

Raghu Patel: For AE/Finance alignment: prefer credits over straight discount — easier to track and reverses automatically. @Finance — can we pre-approve 1 month of credits for CS-3928?

Maya Chen: I'll tag renewal risk as P1 and add the soft-landing play to the account notes. Action items I’ll take: 1) Send email + cal link, 2) Schedule enablement via CS-3928, 3) Add success metrics to account plan, 4) Add 2-question feedback survey to post-session workflow.

Liam O'Neill: Nice. Quick Ops note — we should implement a short automation: if success metrics met within 30 days, auto-flag for upsell outreach and remove downgrade tag. I can file an ops ticket.

Raghu Patel: Also capture a rollback/migration plan in the ticket: export paths, data retention guarantees, and a 1-week dedicated migration window if they decide to leave. Helps legal/customer confidence.

Samira Gomez: I'll craft the 2-question survey and the enablement checklist (checklist items: use-case walkthrough, prompting templates, monitoring dashboard setup, sample prompts).

Maya Chen: Thanks all — I’ll run this and update CS-3928 with notes. Will post a short follow-up after the session with results and feedback. :pray:
